4d80bf0aa0027f15.description: About the Role Flow Progressive Logistics is seeking a Transportation Product Manager to join their team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves owning the strategy, lifecycle, pricing, and P&L for transportation products, ensuring they are compliant, scalable, and profitable. The Product Manager will define propositions, capacity requirements, and the digital roadmap, collaborating with various departments to ensure end-to-end product performance and governance. Key Responsibilities Define the product vision, value proposition, roadmap, and target customer segments. Prioritize opportunities based on customer insight, market and competitor intelligence, and performance data. Manage business cases, product approvals, launches, adoption, continuous improvement, and retirement. Define service and capacity requirements, while Fleet and Operations manage assets and daily execution. Own product budgets, forecasts, P&L performance, and implement corrective actions. Set rate architecture, route-to-serve, margin floors, and pricing governance in collaboration with Finance. Support Sales with solution design, key bids, product expertise, and bundled propositions. Define service scope, SLAs, operating model, and documentation standards. Partner with operations to ensure on-time delivery, capacity availability, and service quality. Monitor product performance, KPIs, costs, claims, penalties, and customer satisfaction, driving corrective actions as needed. Ensure product and operations compliance with licensing, regulations, safety, customs interfaces, and insurance requirements. Monitor service risks and maintain business continuity plans. Ensure proper permits, clearances, and documentation for cross-border and domestic operations. Prioritize TMS, GPS, POD, and other digital tools to enhance visibility and operational efficiency. Set product KPIs and reports, driving data quality, standardization, and adoption. Govern product changes, platform enhancements, and user readiness. Collaboration and Ownership This role requires close collaboration with Sales for growth initiatives, and with Operations and Finance for execution. While Commercial teams manage customer relationships and contracts, the Product Manager is responsible for the offer and its economic viability. The Product Manager will also work with various stakeholders to convert customer, market, and regulatory needs into compliant, scalable, and profitable services. Required Experience Candidates should possess 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in product management, specifically within the transportation or logistics sector. This experience should include managing product lifecycles, P&L responsibilities, and defining product strategies. Location and Work Type This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities covering operations in both Jeddah and Makkah. The role requires a strong presence and understanding of the regional logistics landscape. Application Process The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process. Interested candidates are encouraged to apply to contribute to the strategic growth of transportation products at Flow Progressive Logistics.

4d9c1988f505ff0b.description: About the Role Al-Watania Poultry (Saudi Arabia) is seeking a Maintenance Electrician to join their team in Al Qassim. This full-time role involves ensuring the continuous and problem-free operation of all machinery and production lines within the facility. The successful candidate will be responsible for addressing daily faults and implementing scheduled maintenance programs to maintain operational readiness. Key Responsibilities Perform maintenance work and execute maintenance programs for various equipment throughout the factory. Document all completed work, including detailed information regarding tasks performed. Monitor and track the performance of production lines and all machinery. Prepare and submit reports to the department supervisor regarding maintenance activities and equipment status. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to identify and resolve daily electrical faults in industrial machinery. Experience in implementing scheduled maintenance programs. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Qassim, Saudi Arabia, within a dynamic production environment. The role requires proactive engagement with machinery and production lines to ensure optimal performance and minimal downtime. Company Overview Al-Watania Poultry is a leading poultry company in Saudi Arabia, committed to maintaining high standards of production and operational efficiency. The company values skilled professionals who contribute to the reliability and continuity of its operations. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4dff04a9677aa0a7.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers worldwide. The company generated over $79 billion in net revenue in 2021, driven by a portfolio that includes iconic brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. PepsiCo operates with a vision to be the global leader by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), an end-to-end transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. Role Overview As a Preseller within the sales team, this full-time role is central to maximizing PepsiCo's on-shelf presence in all served outlets. The Preseller is responsible for ensuring adherence to planograms for both on and off-shelf displays and reporting any non-compliance. This position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Call on specific OT outlets according to the daily journey plan provided by the supervisor. Merchandise SSFL products within assigned OT stores across various access points, including shelves, stands, and floor displays. Place Point of Sale (POS) material next to SSFL displays where applicable. Ensure all access points are merchandised in accordance with approved planograms. Rotate products using the FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method and remove sub-standard products. Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on the shelf at all times. Monitor and report competitive activities in the market. Report any deviations from agreed terms with assigned OT customers or outlets. Report daily activities of the prior day to the supervisor. Participate in sampling and redemption campaigns when required. Maintain an appropriate personal appearance and professional behavior in line with the Frito Lay code of conduct. Performance Measures Execution Standard. LTA enforcement. Journey plan adherence. Required Experience 0-1 years of relevant experience. Work Type This is a full-time position.

4d4eea6daf4a6617.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a BIM Engineer to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time position supports the delivery of a significant mega infrastructure and landscape development project. The project involves large-scale infrastructure networks, utilities, transportation systems, public realm developments, landscape assets, smart city technologies, and multidisciplinary engineering components, all managed within a collaborative digital environment. Role Overview The BIM Engineer will be responsible for implementing and maintaining Building Information Modelling (BIM) processes throughout the project lifecycle. Working within the PMCM team, this role involves supporting the development, coordination, validation, and management of BIM models, digital delivery standards, and information management processes. The position requires close collaboration with design consultants, contractors, project managers, and various stakeholders to facilitate model-based planning, design coordination, construction management, and asset information delivery. Key Responsibilities Support the implementation of project BIM Execution Plans (BEP), information management strategies, and digital delivery requirements. Review and validate BIM models, drawings, and associated project information to ensure compliance with client standards and project objectives. Coordinate multidisciplinary BIM models across civil, structural, utilities, landscape, architectural, mechanical, electrical, and infrastructure disciplines. Facilitate clash detection, model coordination, constructability reviews, and issue resolution using BIM platforms and collaboration tools. Monitor BIM deliverables from consultants and contractors to ensure quality, consistency, and compliance with project BIM standards. Support the integration of BIM with GIS, digital twin platforms, asset information models, and other project technologies where applicable. Maintain Common Data Environment (CDE) workflows and ensure effective information exchange between project stakeholders. Generate and review model-based outputs including drawings, schedules, quantity take-offs, visualizations, and construction sequencing simulations. Assist project teams in implementing 4D and 5D BIM methodologies to support planning, scheduling, and cost management activities. Conduct BIM model audits, quality assurance reviews, and compliance checks throughout the project lifecycle. Provide BIM technical support and guidance to project teams, consultants, contractors, and stakeholders. Assist with data management, asset information requirements, and digital handover deliverables. Participate in digital engineering workshops, coordination meetings, and innovation initiatives supporting project delivery. Ensure compliance with international BIM standards, client requirements, and PMCM governance procedures. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Architecture, Structural Engineering, Construction Management, Digital Engineering, or a related discipline. Minimum of 6-12 years of experience in BIM delivery, digital engineering, or information management on major infrastructure, landscape, transportation, or urban development projects. Proven experience working on large-scale multidisciplinary infrastructure projects involving BIM implementation and model coordination. Strong knowledge of BIM processes, information management principles, model coordination, clash detection, and digital delivery workflows. Proficiency in Autodesk Revit, Civil 3D, Navisworks, BIM 360 / Autodesk Construction Cloud, Bentley OpenBuildings, ProjectWise, or similar BIM platforms. Experience with Common Data Environments (CDE), ISO 19650 standards, BIM Execution Plans, and project information management processes. Familiarity with GIS integration, digital twins, asset information models, 4D sequencing, and 5D BIM methodologies is highly desirable. Experience reviewing consultant and contractor BIM submissions, models, deliverables, and compliance requirements. Strong understanding of infrastructure, utilities, transportation, landscape, and public realm project delivery environments. Excellent analytical, coordination, communication, and stakeholder management skills. Experience working within PMCM, consultancy, owner representative, or client-side organizations is preferred. Knowledge of scripting, automation tools, Dynamo, Power BI, or digital engineering workflows would be advantageous. Previous GCC project experience, particularly on major Saudi Arabian infrastructure developments, is highly desirable. Work Environment This role is based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time position within the AtkinsRéalis team, supporting a flagship mega infrastructure and landscape development project. Application Process Candidates meeting the specified requirements are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4dac8fa64deec15a.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن شركة اعالي الاركان للمقاولات عن حاجتها لمدير عمليات تشغيل (Chief Operating Officer - COO) للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور مسؤولية الإشراف المباشر على تخطيط وتنظيم عمليات تشغيل المعدات المختلفة، والمساهمة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والتشغيلية لضمان سير العمليات بأعلى مستويات الكفاءة والفعالية. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط الاستراتيجية والأهداف العامة بما يتوافق مع التوجهات والأولويات المحددة، والمساهمة الفعالة في إدارة وتوجيه وتقييم عمليات التطبيق. متابعة وإدارة وتوجيه الأنشطة المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات، وضمان التطبيق الأمثل لكافة الأنظمة واللوائح والتعليمات والتوجيهات. متابعة عمليات إصدار التراخيص والتصاريح اللازمة بما يتوافق مع المعايير والشروط المعتمدة. المشاركة في مراجعة وتطوير الأنظمة واللوائح والسياسات المتبعة في مجالات تشغيل المعدات، وضمان تطويرها وتحديثها باستمرار. مراجعة ودراسة احتياجات المملكة من الخطوط الحديدية فيما يتعلق بالمعدات. متابعة عمليات إعداد وتحضير تقارير العمل والإنجاز، وعرضها على الإدارة العليا المتخصصة. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بمختلف التحديات والمستجدات المتعلقة بتشغيل المعدات المختلفة، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية لا تقل عن 10 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة بعمليات التشغيل وإدارة المعدات. فهم عميق لعمليات تخطيط وتنظيم تشغيل المعدات المختلفة. القدرة على ضمان توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات بكفاءة. نوع العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل الرياض، المملكة العربية السعودية. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4decffc342d72ba2.description: About the Role Alfanar Projects is seeking a Technician Welding to join their team in Al Khobar, Eastern region. This full-time role involves assembling and repairing metal components using heavy machinery and high heat to shape and join metals. The position requires 2-5 years of relevant experience. Key Responsibilities Read and understand blueprints before commencing projects. Determine the appropriate welding equipment and methods based on project requirements. Source and prepare materials, including measuring and cutting to specifications. Execute the welding process using suitable materials to join metals. Perform quality control checks on finished work to ensure compliance with blueprint tolerances. Operational Accountabilities Communicate effectively with peers and supervisors, demonstrating openness to directions and feedback. Utilize tools and machinery efficiently in terms of cost and time. Execute operational activities according to delivery schedules and work instructions. Assist in resolving operational issues and escalate complex problems as needed. Implement quality standards for products, processes, and related activities. Perform tasks in adherence to established work routines and instructions. Comply with all relevant policies, procedures, and processes. Adhere to all safety procedures and regulations. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 2 to 5 years of experience in welding or a related technical field. Proficiency in reading and interpreting blueprints. Demonstrated ability to operate heavy machinery for welding and metal shaping. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Al Khobar, within the Eastern region. The role involves working with heavy machinery and requires strict adherence to safety protocols.

4d496eefe2635ef7.description: نبحث عن استشاري مبيعات أثاث وتصميم داخلي شغوف للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في تقديم حلول مبتكرة لعملائنا. ستكون مسؤولاً عن فهم احتياجات العملاء وتقديم استشارات متخصصة في الأثاث والتصميم الداخلي، مع التركيز على تحقيق أهداف المبيعات. نهدف إلى توفير تجربة عملاء استثنائية من خلال تقديم منتجات عالية الجودة وخدمات تصميم احترافية. المهام والمسؤوليات: * استقبال العملاء وتقديم استشارات شاملة حول خيارات الأثاث والتصميم الداخلي. * تطوير مفاهيم تصميمية تلبي احتياجات وأذواق العملاء، وتقديم عروض تقديمية احترافية. * إتمام عمليات البيع وتحقيق أهداف المبيعات المحددة، مع متابعة ما بعد البيع لضمان رضا العملاء. * البقاء على اطلاع دائم بأحدث اتجاهات الأثاث والتصميم الداخلي. * التعاون مع فريق العمل لضمان تجربة تسوق سلسة ومميزة للعملاء.

4d018d50629a2d75.description: About the Role Maximus KSA is seeking an Information Security Manager to oversee cybersecurity governance, risk, and compliance for its operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time, hands-on compliance role reporting to the Lead VP, Finance. The position requires 5-10 years of experience in information security. Role Overview The Information Security Manager will be responsible for maintaining the company's information security framework and ensuring compliance with relevant regulations. This role involves managing cybersecurity risks, conducting assessments, and leading audit processes. Candidates should be prepared to lead a small GRC function or step into a leadership role from a Senior GRC Specialist or GRC Lead position. Key Responsibilities Maintain the Information Security Management Framework in alignment with ISO 27001, NCA ECC, and SDAIA requirements. Manage the cybersecurity risk register and conduct risk assessments for new systems, projects, cloud services, and suppliers. Execute compliance and control reviews, coordinate internal and external audits, and ensure findings are addressed. Develop and maintain information security policies, standards, and procedures. Oversee supplier security and third-party risk management. Collaborate with the Legal department to ensure data protection compliance with the Saudi PDPL. Report compliance status, KPIs, and incidents to executive management. Conduct security awareness and training programs across the business. Serve as the primary contact for regulators, auditors, and external assessors. Lead, coach, and develop the information security team. Qualifications and Experience Saudi national is required. A minimum of 6 years of experience in information security, GRC, or IT audit, including leadership experience in projects or people management. Practical experience with NCA ECC, ISO 27001, and PDPL. SAMA experience is an advantage. Experience in leading or supporting ISO 27001 audits. Possession of at least one of the following certifications: CISA, CISM, ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer. CRISC, CDPSE, or CIPM certifications are a bonus. Bachelor’s degree in Information Security, Computer Science, Risk Management, or a related field. Strong report writing and stakeholder communication skills in both English and Arabic.

4d0b2bcb4c73692e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Director - Procurement - Residential - Saudi National to lead procurement operations. This full-time leadership position involves strategic oversight of procurement activities specifically for the company's residential projects portfolio. The role focuses on ensuring the delivery of high-quality materials and services while optimizing costs and maintaining compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Key Responsibilities Develop, implement, and manage procurement strategies aligned with the company’s residential project goals. Oversee procurement planning, sourcing, contract negotiation, and supplier relationship management. Collaborate with project teams and other departments to forecast procurement needs and ensure timely delivery. Drive continuous improvement initiatives in procurement processes to enhance efficiency, reduce risk, and maximize value. Maintain compliance with relevant laws, regulations, and internal policies, including sustainability and local content requirements. Lead and mentor the procurement team to achieve operational excellence and foster professional growth. Monitor market trends, supplier performance, and industry innovations to capitalize on new opportunities. Prepare and present procurement reports and metrics for senior management and stakeholders. Promote ethical sourcing and corporate social responsibility throughout procurement activities. Candidate Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in procurement, with a focus on residential projects. Demonstrated leadership experience in managing procurement operations and teams. Strong understanding of procurement strategies, contract negotiation, and supplier management. Ability to ensure compliance with company policies and regulatory requirements. Work Type This is a full-time position within Qiddiya Investment Company. Application Information The salary for this position will be discussed during the interview process.

4d2de632b9372e9e.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager, Construction Management. This full-time role involves leading the execution and delivery of large-scale construction projects, ensuring they are completed safely, on schedule, within budget, and in accordance with quality standards and project objectives. The Senior Manager will oversee contractors, consultants, and project teams throughout the construction lifecycle, focusing on operational excellence and effective stakeholder management. Key Responsibilities Lead all construction activities from mobilization through project completion and handover. Manage contractors, consultants, and site supervision teams to achieve project delivery objectives. Monitor project schedules, budgets, resources, and construction performance. Ensure compliance with project specifications, quality standards, regulatory requirements, and health and safety policies. Oversee construction planning, sequencing, and execution strategies. Identify project risks and implement mitigation measures to minimize impacts on cost, schedule, and quality. Review and manage contractor progress, change orders, claims, and commercial issues. Coordinate with design, project management, procurement, HSE, and operations teams to ensure seamless project delivery. Lead site meetings, progress reviews, and stakeholder engagement activities. Drive value engineering, constructability reviews, and productivity improvement initiatives. Ensure timely resolution of technical, construction, and interface issues. Prepare executive reports and provide regular updates to senior leadership. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, or a related field. A minimum of 12 years of experience in construction management, with significant experience in delivering large-scale infrastructure, residential, mixed-use, or major development projects. Proven track record in managing contractors, consultants, and multidisciplinary project teams. Strong understanding of construction methodologies, project controls, contract administration, and quality management. Experience working on complex master-planned developments, mega projects, or large infrastructure programs is highly preferred. Professional certifications such as PMP, CCM, PE, or equivalent are advantageous. Work Type This is a full-time position.

4d4f6a3764c510b4.description: About Air Products and the Role Air Products is seeking a Senior Principal Engineer Electrical to provide technical leadership and act as the site electrical engineering consultant for the NEOM Green Hydrogen Plant (GHE). This full-time position is based in Duba, Tabuk, Neom, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on ensuring the safe, reliable, and cost-effective delivery of electrical systems through construction, pre-commissioning, commissioning & start-up (CSU), and operation. The successful candidate will drive the resolution of complex technical challenges and enable cross-functional alignment for plant energization. Role Scope and Responsibilities This position involves providing electrical engineering leadership and site support across various process units within the Neom Green Hydrogen Plant, including the Air Separation Unit (ASU), Alkaline Water Electrolysis (AWE)/Hydrogen Production, Ammonia plant, and associated utilities. The role operates within a multi-disciplinary, multi-contractor EPC environment, requiring interfaces with Project Management, Construction, Pre-Commissioning, CSU, and NGHC Operations teams, as well as vendors and OEMs. Key responsibilities include: Leading and supervising site electrical engineering activities to ensure safe, high-quality, and timely execution. Resolving complex and critical issues through structured problem definition, troubleshooting, root cause analysis (RCA), and effective solution implementation. Driving site electrical engineering execution by responding to TQs/RFIs, closing walkdown punch items, and completing Electrical Operational Readiness Inspections (ORI). Managing Field Change Notices (FCNs) for temporary site modifications and ensuring accurate RLM/as-built records. Coordinating effectively with Project Management, Construction, Pre-Commissioning, CSU, and Operations teams. Managing interfaces with EPC construction contractors, vendors, and OEMs to support troubleshooting from construction through start-up. Demonstrating expertise in large rotating equipment and drive systems, including STG, standby generators, motors, MV/LV VSDs/VFDs, and soft starters. Leading interface coordination and integration of the GHE plant with Power Generation (solar, wind, BESS) and grid systems, ensuring compliance with the Saudi Grid Code. Preparing and reviewing as-built markups for key electrical deliverables, including distribution systems, grounding, lighting, hazardous area classification, and protection schemes. Ensuring electrical designs comply with Air Products standards, Local Saudi Standards (*, HCIS, SBC, Saudi National Grid Code), and international codes (IEC/IEEE/NFPA/IS). Participating in 3D model reviews, design reviews, and constructability assessments. Safety and Compliance The Senior Principal Engineer Electrical is responsible for ensuring all electrical engineering activities comply with Air Products Safety Principles. This includes embedding safe-to-maintain, safe-to-operate, and safe-to-construct philosophies into designs. Participation in HAZID, HAZOP, electrical safety reviews, and engineering audits is required, along with adherence to regulatory and environmental compliance requirements. Required Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess a strong background in electrical engineering within industrial plant environments. Specific requirements include: 15-20 years of experience in electrical engineering. Demonstrated expertise in MV/LV distribution, electrical substations, SCADA, large rotating equipment, drive systems, rectifiers, and protection schemes. Advanced knowledge of power quality and grid integration, including harmonics filters, STATCOM/dynamic reactive compensation, power factor correction, and load shedding. Proficiency in system studies (Load Flow, Motor Starting, Short Circuit) using software such as ETAP or SKM. Strong engineering judgment and timely decision-making skills for complex technical challenges. Ability to mentor and develop engineers and designers, promoting technical excellence and continuous improvement. Work Schedule and Travel This position operates on a rotational schedule of 8 weeks on-site followed by 2 weeks off, subject to NEOM site assignment policy. During on-site periods, employees will work 6 days per week, 10 hours per day (60 hours per week). Domestic or international travel of 0–10% may be required based on project needs. Company Culture At Air Products, the company fosters a culture that values collaboration, accountability, and high-performance. The role encourages promoting "Our Way of Leading" behaviors and strengthening team capability to support predictable, high-quality, and timely project execution.

4d7ddf6afb7854d2.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث كيان الإجادة للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية عن أخصائي قانوني للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم الدعم القانوني للعملاء والمنشآت في مختلف المسائل، مع التركيز على صياغة الوثائق القانونية ومراقبة تنفيذ الأحكام. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تأهيل الطلبات وتقييم الخيارات القانونية المتاحة. إجراء الأبحاث القانونية في البيانات المتعلقة بالقضايا، والسوابق القضائية، والتشريعات المعمول بها. مساعدة العملاء والمنشآت في صياغة الآراء القانونية، والمذكرات التحريرية، وغيرها من المذكرات القانونية. إعداد وصياغة الوثائق القانونية المختلفة مثل الوصايا، والسندات، والعقود. مراجعة الوثائق القانونية ومعالجة المسائل المهمة التي قد تنشأ. مراجعة عقود المنشآت التجارية لتحديد المخاطر المحتملة ومراقبة تنفيذ البنود القانونية. التوسط في النزاعات ومراقبة تنفيذ الأحكام القانونية الصادرة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين إلى خمس سنوات في مجال قانوني ذي صلة. فهم عميق للمسائل القانونية والتشريعات. القدرة على إجراء الأبحاث القانونية وتحليل المعلومات بفعالية. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في صياغة الوثائق القانونية بدقة ووضوح. قدرة على التوسط في النزاعات وتقديم الحلول القانونية. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد المخاطر القانونية. الالتزام بالدقة والتفاصيل في جميع المهام القانونية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وتتطلب الوظيفة التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل ضمن فريق كيان الإجادة للمحاماة والاستشارات القانونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية التوظيف.

4dbb14768a76618d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني أجهزة إلكترونية للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة. يركز هذا الدور على تركيب ومراقبة الأجهزة والمعدات الإلكترونية، بالإضافة إلى تقديم الدعم لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في أنشطة البحث والتطوير. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة المخططات الفنية لتحديد نوع وكمية المواد والمعدات واليد العاملة اللازمة للتركيب. توجيه وتنسيق جهود العمال والميكانيكيين والحرفيين الآخرين أثناء تركيب الأجهزة الإلكترونية. اختبار الأجهزة الإلكترونية بعد التركيب لضمان مطابقتها للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية للصيانة الوقائية وتشخيص الأعطال والتلفيات المحتملة، واتخاذ الإجراءات التصحيحية. تقديم المساعدة التقنية لمهندسي الإلكترونيات في جهود البحث والتطوير المتعلقة بالأجهزة الإلكترونية. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال تركيب وصيانة الأجهزة الإلكترونية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والرسومات الفنية. معرفة جيدة بمكونات الدوائر الإلكترونية وعناصر التحكم والآلات. مهارات تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في المدينة المنورة. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص، ويسهم في ضمان الأداء الفعال والموثوق للأجهزة الإلكترونية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4dbdf3dcb408f1c5.description: About the Role AtkinsRéalis is seeking a Senior Project Manager to join its team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves managing large-scale multi-disciplinary projects within KSA and the GCC Region. The selected candidate will be responsible for ensuring the successful delivery of projects on time, within budget, and in accordance with client requirements. Key Responsibilities Lead and manage projects within the business, ensuring successful delivery. Collaborate with the AtkinsRéalis team and clients to establish project objectives and develop project plans. Manage project budgets and oversee project scheduling. Manage the project team, ensuring timely task completion and consistent communication. Manage project risks, develop contingency plans, and ensure adherence to health and safety standards. Ensure compliance with AtkinsRéalis' project management methodology requirements. Project Delivery and Management Communicate scope, fees, deliverables, and program details to the team through project kick-offs and regular updates. Manage sub-consultant agreements and payments. Ensure the Project Execution Plan addresses design management requirements, including integration and interface management between client requirements and sub-consultant design packages. Support the Project Director (PD) and Project Manager (PM) in producing project management documentation and standard forms. Assist in risk identification and management, as well as identifying and managing scope changes and extensions. Identify resourcing issues and requirements, coordinating with Technical Team Leads. Provide timely external and internal monthly reporting by implementing a planned delivery schedule. Ensure adherence to Quality Systems processes in project delivery. Undertake debriefs with clients. Assist in managing projects financially, technically, and contractually. Financial and Client Management Monitor Design Team progress and costs, highlighting discrepancies and coordinating with Project Technical Leads to mitigate potential over-runs or underspends. Demonstrate a strong understanding of risk and apply commercial acumen. Proactively manage risks using provided tools, regular team and client engagement, and update contingency requirements regularly (at least once per design stage). Prepare invoices for review and sign-off by the Project Director and maintain up-to-date financial registers. Liaise and interact with clients regarding the technical delivery components of projects. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in project management. Proven experience managing large-scale multi-disciplinary projects within KSA and the GCC Region. Strong understanding of project management methodologies and best practices. Demonstrated ability to manage project teams, budgets, and schedules effectively. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Riyadh, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, within the AtkinsRéalis team. The role requires active engagement with both internal teams and external clients across the KSA and GCC regions.

4def416a8fd7b75f.description: About Crossfield Engineering Services (CES) Crossfield Engineering Services (CES) is a UK-based consultancy specializing in project management consultancy (PMC), PMO, project controls, construction management, commercial procurement, and facilities management services. The company operates across Saudi Arabia, the UAE, and the UK, supporting complex infrastructure, real estate, and operational programs. CES works with clients from governance through construction to operations, aiming to deliver projects efficiently and effectively. Team members collaborate with international stakeholders and gain exposure to large-scale developments in the region. Role Overview CES is seeking an Associate Consultant – Facilities Management for a full-time, on-site position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This role supports senior consultants in assessing and improving facilities management strategies for complex infrastructure and real estate assets. The position requires 0-1 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Gathering operational data related to facilities management. Assisting in facilities audits to evaluate current practices. Preparing reports and presentations based on findings and recommendations. Contributing to the development of FM operating models, procedures, and service level agreements. Helping coordinate with clients, service providers, and internal teams to ensure alignment between facilities operations, procurement strategies, and overall project objectives. Supporting the implementation of best practices in facilities and operations management. Tracking performance metrics to monitor effectiveness. Contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within facilities and operations management. Required Experience 0-1 years of professional experience, preferably in a related field. Work Environment This is an on-site, full-time position located in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a collaborative environment that supports large-scale, high-impact developments.

4df45b6726d50119.description: About Equisy Equisy is an AI-powered investment and fundraising platform that connects startups, investors, and the entrepreneurial ecosystem. The company's mission is to streamline the investment process by assisting startups in becoming investment-ready, connecting them with relevant investors, and managing their fundraising activities. Equisy is expanding its presence in Saudi Arabia. About the Internship Equisy is seeking a Sales & Clients Acquisition Intern to support its growth in Saudi Arabia. This internship offers the opportunity to engage with startup founders, understand fundraising challenges, introduce technology solutions, and contribute to customer acquisition strategies. This is a commission-based opportunity, with earning potential linked to successful customer acquisition based on an agreed commission structure. Exceptional performance may lead to a full-time position, subject to business needs and mutual agreement. Key Responsibilities Identify and engage promising startups across Saudi Arabia. Build and maintain a structured database of startup founders and decision-makers. Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email, startup communities, and professional networks. Introduce Equisy's platform and explain its value to potential customers. Conduct initial discovery conversations and coordinate platform demonstrations. Support startup onboarding and conversion into active platform users. Research Saudi startup communities, incubators, accelerators, and entrepreneurship programs. Identify opportunities to reach startup founders through strategic ecosystem relationships. Participate in startup events and networking activities when appropriate. Gather market insights and customer feedback to support Equisy's growth strategy. Track outreach, leads, meetings, demos, and customer acquisition activities. Maintain accurate CRM records and follow up with prospective customers. Provide regular updates on acquisition progress, opportunities, and challenges. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 year of experience. Passion for startups, entrepreneurship, and business development. Motivation to contribute to Equisy's customer acquisition strategy. Benefits of the Internship Gain real business experience in customer acquisition and startup growth. Connect with entrepreneurs, startup founders, and ecosystem leaders. Develop practical skills in prospecting, sales, negotiation, and relationship management. Understand how startups prepare for investment and raise capital. Build professional relationships that can create long-term career opportunities. Gain first-hand exposure to scaling a technology venture in Saudi Arabia. Work Environment This internship is based in Saudi Arabia. Interns will actively contribute to building Equisy's market presence, acquiring customers, and creating opportunities across the Saudi entrepreneurial ecosystem.

4d0fa9256fe0b80b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة Ninja عن موظف علاقات حكومية للانضمام إلى فريقها. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى إدارة المعاملات الحكومية اليومية وضمان الامتثال للمتطلبات واللوائح الحكومية، بالإضافة إلى الحفاظ على سريان تراخيص الشركة وتصاريحها. المسؤوليات الرئيسية إصدار وتجديد التراخيص والتصاريح الحكومية المختلفة، بما في ذلك رخص البلدية، وتراخيص الهيئة العامة للنقل (TGA)، والدفاع المدني، وتراخيص المصانع. استخراج وتجديد الشهادات الصحية للعمالة والتأكد من سريانها بشكل مستمر. متابعة المخالفات والغرامات الحكومية والعمل على معالجتها وإغلاقها ضمن الأطر الزمنية المحددة. تنفيذ المعاملات الحكومية عبر المنصات الإلكترونية مثل قوى، ومقيم، وأبشر أعمال، وبلدي، وسلامة، ووزارة الاستثمار (MISA)، وغيرها من المنصات ذات الصلة. التنسيق الفعال مع الجهات الحكومية بخصوص التراخيص، والمخالفات، وعمليات التفتيش، والمتطلبات التنظيمية. متابعة تواريخ انتهاء صلاحية التراخيص، والتصاريح، والشهادات الصحية، وضمان تجديدها في الوقت المناسب. حفظ وتحديث سجلات المستندات الحكومية، والتراخيص، والمخالفات، والمعاملات ذات الصلة. ضمان الالتزام الكامل بالأنظمة واللوائح الحكومية ومتطلبات إصدار التراخيص. المؤهلات والخبرات درجة البكالوريوس في تخصص ذي صلة. خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين و6 سنوات في مجال العلاقات الحكومية داخل المملكة العربية السعودية. خبرة مثبتة في استخدام المنصات الحكومية مثل قوى، ومقيم، وأبشر أعمال، وبلدي، وسلامة. معرفة شاملة بإجراءات إصدار وتجديد تراخيص المصانع، والشهادات الصحية للعمالة، ومتابعة المخالفات والغرامات الحكومية ومعالجتها. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة. قدرة عالية على التنسيق والمتابعة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة Ninja، وتتطلب الالتزام بالمهام الموكلة لضمان سير العمل الحكومي بسلاسة وفعالية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة غير معلن.

4d04723e492bb99e.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فيتال لايف الطبي عن فني مختبر طبي للانضمام إلى فريقها في أبها، عسير. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ومناسب للمرشحين ذوي الخبرة من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، حيث سيتولى مسؤولية إجراء الفحوصات المخبرية المتنوعة وضمان دقة النتائج. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تفقد وتشغيل وصيانة معدات حفظ وفحص العينات، وضبطها وفقاً لنوع الفحص المطلوب ومراقبة أدائها. دراسة طلبات الأطباء لتحديد الفحوصات المطلوبة، وسحب عينات الدم، واستلام عينات البول والبراز. تدوين بيانات المرضى على العينات وحفظها وفقاً لأسس الحفظ الصحيحة والمعتمدة. تحضير العينات للفحص والزراعة، واختيار مواد الفحص بالكميات والمواصفات المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات المختلفة والتحاليل الكيميائية والفيزيائية والمجهرية على العينات. استخراج نتائج الفحوصات وتوثيقها بدقة. إتلاف العينات بعد الانتهاء من الفحوصات وتوثيق إجراءات الإتلاف المتبعة. إعداد وتقديم تقارير العمل الدورية وتوثيقها وحفظها بشكل منظم. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المختبرات الطبية. القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. موقع العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة أبها بمنطقة عسير. نوع التوظيف هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

4d096964329e0311.description: About the Role of Media Manager WPP Media is seeking a Manager Media to join their team in Riyadh, Al Saudia, Saudi Arabia. This is a full-time position requiring 2-5 years of experience. The Media Manager will be responsible for driving brand growth and engagement through the development and execution of innovative media strategies across diverse channels. This role ensures that media plans align with marketing strategies and are optimized for maximum ROI, requiring a strong understanding of both traditional and digital media. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement comprehensive media strategies across various channels, including digital, social, print, and broadcast. Plan, execute, and optimize media campaigns across paid, earned, and owned media channels. Collaborate with content creators, designers, and other team members to develop media content that aligns with the brand’s voice and goals. Allocate and manage media budgets to maximize return on investment (ROI) while adhering to the marketing budget. Track and analyze performance metrics for media campaigns, providing regular reports and recommendations for improvement. Build and maintain relationships with media outlets, influencers, and advertising agencies. Assist in managing crisis communication and reputation management via media outlets as needed. Required Experience and Skills Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience. The role requires an individual who embraces WPP & WPP Media’s core values, which include: Leading collectively to inspire transformational creativity. Creating an open environment by balancing people and client experiences through cultivating trust. Leading optimistically by championing growth and development to mobilize the enterprise. Work Environment and Culture WPP Media is committed to investing in its employees and fostering a culture of respect and belonging. Employees have access to global WPP Media & WPP networks for professional growth and learning. The company hosts frequent in-office events and supports various employee resource groups. WPP Media operates on a hybrid work model, with teams typically in the office around four days a week to foster creativity, collaboration, and connection. Accommodations or flexibility can be discussed with the hiring team during the interview process.

4d09b4c251cad85c.description: About Red Sea Security Red Sea Security, a subsidiary of Red Sea Global, is dedicated to providing world-class, seamless, and invisible security services tailored for the tourism sector, aligning with the 2030 vision. The company operates in Tabuk, specifically in Umluj and Tabuk cities. Role Overview The Assistant Commercial Manager supports the Commercial Manager across all four commercial functions and deputizes as needed. This full-time role prioritizes contract governance, standardization, and the day-to-day execution of tenders and deals. The position also involves supporting pricing and margin analysis, as well as performance oversight, with the expectation that the focus will narrow as the team expands. Key Responsibilities Maintain standardized contract templates, covering scope, terms and conditions, and key performance indicators for intercompany and external market agreements. Manage the Intercompany Agreement and purchase order process with Red Sea Global Procurement and Finance, ensuring the Commercial Contract Registry remains the single source of truth for all agreements. Review the existing contract portfolio (over 60 contracts) against established standards, identifying loss-making contracts, unbilled revenue, missing key performance indicators, and inconsistent terms. Cultivate relationships with existing clients, drive contract renewals, and identify opportunities to expand the scope of current contracts; track renewal dates and variation orders. Manage the bid register, prepare submission documents, conduct compliance checks against tender requirements, draft contracts, and coordinate inputs from Operations, Human Resources, Finance, and Systems & Technology on live deals. Support pricing and margin analysis by keeping the pricing catalog and costing inputs up to date and gathering margin data with Finance. Assist in building, correcting, and auditing performance processes across departments, including client satisfaction surveys and checklists. Engage directly with clients to validate performance data and consolidate results into regular performance reports. Deputize for the Commercial Manager during absences and escalate risks and deadlines in a timely manner. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5 to 10 years of relevant experience in a commercial or contracts management role. Demonstrated experience in contract governance, tender management, and deal execution. Proficiency in managing client relationships and identifying growth opportunities within existing contracts. Work Type This is a full-time position based in Tabuk, serving the Umluj and Tabuk regions. Application Process Qualified candidates are invited to apply for this role. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4d7d1844e66a7081.description: About the Role Hill International, Inc. is seeking an experienced MEP Resident Engineer to join their team in Dammam, Eastern Region. This is a full-time position focused on leading the construction supervision of all Mechanical, Electrical, and Plumbing (MEP) works for villas and infrastructure projects. Key Responsibilities Lead the construction supervision for all MEP works related to villas and infrastructure. Manage MEP engineers and inspectors, ensuring adequate supervision across all active work fronts. Oversee the review process for MEP shop drawings, material submittals, method statements, Inspection and Test Plans (ITPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and technical queries. Monitor site installations to ensure compliance with approved Issued For Construction (IFC) drawings, shop drawings, specifications, codes, and approved materials. Manage Work Inspection Requests (WIR) and Material Inspection Requests (MIR) inspections, and follow up on Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs), identified deficiencies, and corrective actions. Coordinate MEP works effectively with structural, architectural, landscape, and infrastructure disciplines. Monitor MEP progress, identify potential constraints, and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions. Lead the testing, commissioning, snagging, de-snagging, and handover processes for MEP systems. Coordinate with the Client, Project Management Consultant (PMC), Contractor, designers, and relevant authorities. Ensure full compliance with project quality, Health, Safety, and Environment (HSE), and contractual requirements. Candidate Requirements A minimum of 10 years of experience in MEP construction supervision. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage MEP teams and project processes. Strong understanding of MEP systems for villas and infrastructure projects. Proficiency in reviewing technical documents and ensuring compliance with project standards. Work Type This is a full-time position. Location The role is based in Dammam, Eastern Region. Application Process Salary information for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

4d927307c34c0dd8.description: About The First Group The First Group is seeking a Front Desk Agent (Saudi National) to join their team in Jeddah. This full-time role is designed for individuals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on providing a welcoming and efficient experience for guests and members. Role Overview The Front Desk Agent serves as the primary point of contact for guests and members at Silver Sands Beach. This position is crucial for ensuring smooth operations at the front desk, handling inquiries, managing check-ins, processing reservations, and addressing daily guest needs to support an enjoyable experience. Key Responsibilities Warmly and professionally welcome guests and members. Manage arrivals, check-ins, registrations, and related front desk procedures. Respond to questions regarding the beach, facilities, services, opening hours, and policies. Handle reservations and bookings, ensuring accuracy of guest information and records. Answer phone calls and direct inquiries to the appropriate team members. Coordinate with other departments to promptly resolve guest requests. Address concerns courteously and escalate issues when necessary. Process payments and transactions in accordance with company procedures. Maintain an organized front desk and a professional reception area. Adhere to company service standards, safety procedures, and applicable local requirements. Qualifications and Experience 0-1 years of experience in a related field. Must be a Saudi National. Demonstrated ability to provide excellent customer service. Work Environment This role is based in Jeddah at Silver Sands Beach, operating in a dynamic environment focused on guest satisfaction. The position requires a proactive approach to managing daily front desk operations and interacting with a diverse clientele. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the qualifications are encouraged to apply for this full-time position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

4d973aa0a3951893.description: About the Role Eram Talent is seeking a Mechanical Trainer for one of its Oil & Gas clients in Saudi Arabia. This full-time role focuses on delivering technical training in mechanical maintenance, covering both rotating and static equipment. The primary objective is to enhance workforce competency, ensure adherence to industry standards, and meet operational requirements. Key Responsibilities Deliver theoretical and practical training on mechanical equipment, maintenance procedures, and troubleshooting techniques. Conduct hands-on training for various equipment including rotating and static machinery, compressors, gas and steam turbines, engines, gearboxes, and mechanical seals. Provide instruction on equipment alignment, lubrication, vibration analysis, machining, and overhaul procedures. Offer technical guidance on relief valves, valve actuators, and Motor Operated Valve (MOV) actuators. Develop and deliver comprehensive training materials, practical demonstrations, and competency assessments. Evaluate trainee performance and identify areas requiring further technical development. Ensure all training activities comply with applicable Oil & Gas industry standards, safety protocols, and operational requirements. Maintain accurate training records and provide feedback on trainees’ progress and competency levels. Required Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in mechanical maintenance and training within the Oil & Gas sector. Demonstrated expertise in troubleshooting and overhaul practices for mechanical equipment. Strong understanding of industry standards and operational requirements in mechanical maintenance. Skills and Competencies Ability to deliver effective theoretical and practical training sessions. Proficiency in developing and assessing training materials. Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for instructing diverse groups. Commitment to safety procedures and operational excellence. Work Environment This role is based in Saudi Arabia, supporting a prestigious client in the Oil & Gas industry. Department Marketing, KSA affiliate, International Operations Your impact begins here As Sr. Manager, Brand Marketing, you will own the integrated brand and portfolio strategy for our diabetes business in Saudi Arabia.
